text: Generalized BoundSchedule once over identified axis keys, then implemented open typed RandomizationActionPlan with permutation and sign-flip families, sample/partition exchangeability, explicit statistic reduction, exact labels and axis checks, and domain-separated deterministic sign-flip streams.
